question:
I really like Tarko from Re Lost in Memories. If Liliana met Tarko, could Liliana have one of those “musical sparks” after being struck by Tarko’s singing ability, and the two of them end up singing a duet? Also, is there any chance Tarko might appear in a short story or side story?
(※ Re Lost in Memories = Re −Starting Life in Another World− Lost in Memories. Tarko is an original character who appeared in New Chapter 3, Elegy of the Dog Demon.)
answer:
Tarko has the setting that he's a good singer, so he sings among the mercenaries when everyone in the mercenary group gets together.

If he met Liliana, I could see Liliana getting that “spark,” starting to sing, Tarko joining in, and the whole thing turning into something pretty interesting. (laughs)

The characters who appear in the Re:Zero games are also characters whose settings I worked on together with the people involved, so if I get the opportunity, I'd like to have as many of them as possible appear in the main story as well.
